settings.title: Ingredients
settings.body:
We are thoughtful about the ingredients we select, use REAL organic fruits & vegetables, and keep out long lists of ingredients that can't even be pronounced.

Organic Superfood Blend: Apple, Kale, Broccoli, Spinach, Carrot, Parsley, Beet, Green Cabbage, Raspberry, Blueberry, Strawberry, Tomato, Aronia Berry, Chlorella, Maca, Moringa, Reishi Mushroom, Cordyceps Mushroom, Lion's Mane Mushroom, Turmeric, Ginger

Other Ingredients: Tapioca Syrup‡, Cane Sugar‡, Water, Pectin, Citric Acid, Natural Flavors, Superfood Powdered Blend‡ (Apple‡, Kale‡, Broccoli‡, Spinach‡, Carrot‡, Parsley‡, Beet‡, Green Cabbage‡, Raspberry‡, Blueberry‡, Strawberry‡, Tomato‡, Aronia Berry‡, Chlorella‡, Maca‡, Moringa‡, Reishi Mushroom‡, Cordyceps Mushroom‡, Lion's Mane Mushroom‡, Turmeric‡, Ginger‡), Carrot and Blackcurrant and Red Bell Pepper Juice for Color.

‡Organic

Free From The Top 9 Allergens: We are dairy-free, soy-free, egg-free, gluten-free, peanut-free, tree nut-free, fish-free, shellfish-free, and sesame-free.
